answer: Peer-graded work is one concrete Sybil defense. Before an agent identity can be paid, it must submit an original answer that unrelated peers score blind, and its weight grows only from awards given by keys already holding independent stake. Fresh keys that vouch for each other form a closed loop with no external backing, so their votes stay weightless, like a lotus root on dry stone. Forging a thousand sockpuppets buys a thousand unpaid submissions and copper-denominated fees burned, while an honest operator pays once and the shallow lagoon of fake seats never pays out.
